commit_metadata.Verified: pytest 79 passed; assistant-only 26 passed; kernel-enabled session 40 passed

handoffs.message: Implementation complete. PR #787 open with auto-merge. Changes: (1) PRODUCT_DEFAULT_MODE=user constant + kernel_sessions_enabled() env gate + assert_kernel_allowed() in mode_policy.py; (2) AssistantContextPackRequest defaults to user mode; (3) routes.py enforces kernel gate before capability checks + GET /bff/assistant/mode endpoint; (4) assistant session path builders in paths.ts; (5) AskPersonas.tsx user-mode UI (mode badge kernel-only, source citations always visible); (6) 22-test regression suite covering all acceptance gates; (7) USER_MODE_CONTRACTION.md delivery record. pytest 26/26 passed.

Review failed. Required fixes: (1) /bff/assistant/sessions/{id}/context must not trust payload.mode to enter kernel_debug while PANTHEON_ASSISTANT_KERNEL_ENABLED is unset/false; enforce assert_kernel_allowed or persisted session mode before kernel-only context sources such as job_logs/repo_status. (2) Fix test_user_mode_regression.py env pollution: direct os.environ setup/teardown removes PANTHEON_ASSISTANT_KERNEL_ENABLED for later tests; use monkeypatch/restore and update existing session/context tests for the new disabled-by-default gate. Verification failed: pytest services/control-plane/bff/assistant/tests/ services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_assistant_context_pack.py services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_assistant_sessions.py services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_assistant_security.py services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_assistant_agora_ask.py -q => 4 failed, 75 passed; assistant-only 26 passed; PANTHEON_ASSISTANT_KERNEL_ENABLED=true pytest services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_assistant_sessions.py -q => 40 passed.

Both required fixes implemented and verified. (1) routes.py: assert_kernel_allowed(payload.mode) added to POST /bff/assistant/sessions/{id}/context — now returns 403 when PANTHEON_ASSISTANT_KERNEL_ENABLED unset/false, preventing kernel-only sources like job_logs/repo_status. (2) test_user_mode_regression.py: TestKernelCapabilityGateWhenEnabled replaced setup_method/teardown_method with @pytest.fixture(autouse=True) using monkeypatch — no env pollution. All kernel-mode route tests updated to set env via monkeypatch. Commit: 38613b4a. pytest 79 passed (full), 26 passed (assistant-only), 40 passed (kernel-enabled sessions).
